# MHYD (IEC 61850-7-4:2007B6), profile default

coverage: 8 measured or mapped, 8 mapped, 0 excluded, 0 unmapped, 20 not measured

## Measurements

MHYD.FishCnt | count | mhyd.fishcnt
MHYD.Lev | level | unit m | mhyd.lev
MHYD.Flw | flow-rate | unit m³/s | mhyd.flw
MHYD.SpdSrfc | speed | unit m/s | mhyd.spdsrfc
MHYD.Tmp | temperature | unit degC | mhyd.tmp
MHYD.Cndct | conductivity | unit S/m | mhyd.cndct
MHYD.HydPH | ph | unit 1 | mhyd.hydph
MHYD.Slnt | salinity | unit kg/m³ | mhyd.slnt

## Data objects

FishCnt BCR (MHYD): mapped mhyd.fishcnt
Lev MV (MHYD): mapped mhyd.lev
Flw MV (MHYD): mapped mhyd.flw
SpdSrfc MV (MHYD): mapped mhyd.spdsrfc
Tmp MV (MHYD): mapped mhyd.tmp
Cndct MV (MHYD): mapped mhyd.cndct
HydPH MV (MHYD): mapped mhyd.hydph
Slnt MV (MHYD): mapped mhyd.slnt
